projects.name: personal-site

projects.name: golinks
projects.description: link shortener with click analytics and qr codes on your own domain.

page.pitch: short links on your own domain, with click analytics and a qr code for every link.

features.title: one kv read per redirect
features.detail: the click lands in d1 after the 302 has gone

features.title: a qr code per link
features.detail: png at print sizes, cached at the edge

features.title: password-protected admin
features.detail: clicks per day, countries, devices, referrers

features.title: expiry and click caps
features.detail: plus a json api for scripts

run.note: needs node and wrangler; deploying needs a cloudflare account. it can't live on github pages because every redirect runs on a worker and the clicks sit in d1.

projects.name: linkinbio
projects.description: link-in-bio page with first-party click tracking. zero dependencies.

page.pitch: one page, one json file, and click tracking that never leaves your server.

features.title: links.json is the cms
features.detail: edit the file, the page updates on the next request

features.title: first-party click tracking
features.detail: one tab-separated line per click, no cookies

features.title: /stats behind basic auth
features.detail: clicks per link and per day, referrers, bots split out

features.title: zero dependencies
features.detail: node stdlib only, nothing to pnpm install

commands.comment: then set STATS_USER, STATS_PASS and HASH_SALT

run.note: needs node 20.6+. it can't live on github pages because every click goes through the server's /go/ redirect and lands in its log.

projects.name: qrforge
projects.description: qr generator with editable dynamic codes and scan tracking.

page.pitch: design a qr code, print it, and change where it points later.

features.title: live generator
features.detail: colours, dot styles, a centre logo, png or svg export

features.title: dynamic codes
features.detail: /r/<slug> redirects to a target you can edit

features.title: scan tracking
features.detail: totals, the last 30 days, the latest hits

features.title: no third-party calls
features.detail: one node process, one sqlite file

run.note: needs node 22+. it can't live on github pages because dynamic codes redirect through the server and the scans sit in a sqlite file.

page.pitch: a public form collects testimonials, you approve them, and a wall or one script tag shows them.

features.title: collection form
features.detail: name, role, rating, text, avatar

features.title: nothing shows until approved
features.detail: moderate in /admin behind basic auth

features.title: a hosted wall
features.detail: masonry wall of approved testimonials

features.title: one-tag embed
features.detail: real dom, picks up your site's fonts

run.note: needs node 20.11+. it can't live on github pages because submissions and avatars are stored by the server, in sqlite and on disk.

projects.name: forms
projects.description: a small form builder. responses stay in a sqlite file you control.

page.pitch: build a form, share the link, read the responses, export a csv.

features.title: form builder
features.detail: add and reorder fields in /admin

features.title: a public form per link
features.detail: validated in the browser and again on the server

features.title: responses and csv export
features.detail: file uploads and optional email alerts

features.title: nothing from other origins
features.detail: a content-security-policy header enforces it

run.note: needs node 20+. it can't live on github pages because responses and uploads are written to the server's disk.

projects.name: zcal
projects.description: single-user scheduling: read one calendar, publish your free time, book a slot.

page.pitch: single-user scheduling: read one calendar, publish your free time, someone books a slot.

features.title: one calendar
features.detail: busy blocks, .ics import and export

features.title: booking links
features.detail: length, buffers, notice, how far ahead

features.title: visitors see free times only
features.detail: never your event titles

features.title: booked = written back
features.detail: plus a .ics and a one-time cancel link

run.note: needs node 20.9+. `bootstrap` prints a passphrase: that's your login. it can't live on github pages because your bookings sit in a sqlite file.
